name: flarelobby
description: Cloudflare Workers 向けゲームロビーライブラリのモノレポ
author: katsu996

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flarelobby/core run build && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/cloudflare run build && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/client run build && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/testing run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @flarelobby/core run typecheck && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/cloudflare run typecheck && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/testing run typecheck
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @flarelobby/core exec vitest run --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=json-summary && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/client exec vitest run --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=json-summary && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/testing exec vitest run --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reporter=lcov --coverage.reporter=json-summary && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/cloudflare exec vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @flarelobby/core run test:unit && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/client run test:unit && pnpm --filter @flarelobby/testing run test:unit
scripts.release:check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && node scripts/verify-esm.mjs && pnpm check:worker-types && pnpm check:packages && pnpm check:deploy
